title: Pre-filtered lead (rejected)
description: leads/pre-filtered/*-rejects.json — a lead-deduped record that failed pre-filter's structural gate. Diverges from lead-pre-filtered.schema.json: no eu_flagged/mql_score/title_match requirement (the gate can reject before those are computed), and reject_reason is required instead.

contact_location.description: Contact location as reported by the source, e.g. 'Springfield, Illinois, United States'. Empty if unknown.

company_hq_location.description: Company HQ city/region/country as reported or researched. Empty if unknown.

metro_match.description: How the lead matches icp.locations: contact is in metro | company HQ is in metro | HQ elsewhere but a staffed local office | neither | not determinable. Only meaningful when icp.locations is non-empty.

metro_evidence.description: Source field name or URL backing metro_match, e.g. 'apollo:person.city' or a careers-page URL.

location_flag.description: Set by pre-filter when metro_match is unknown: 'unknown_needs_review'.

signal.description: Why this lead surfaced: local_employer | hiring_people_function | hr_event_organizer | new_office | growth | other. Carried from the company record when people are found at a company.

evidence_url.description: URL backing `signal` (job post, Maps listing, event page).

source_actor.description: Apify actor slug that produced this record, e.g. harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search.

source_id.description: Stable id from the source (LinkedIn public identifier, Maps placeId, job posting id).
